note: A four-view of a Calliope: the T34 launcher on a welded M4 with the direct-vision hoods, an appliqué plate over the ammunition on the left sponson and a stowage bin on the engine deck. No scale on the sheet. The side is taken off the M4A1's running gear: the bogies 112.6 px apart for 57 in and the wheels of each 65 px for 33 in, and the first to the last wheel 290.5 px for 147 in, all at 77.8 px/m. The plan is drawn at the side's scale and in line with it. The front is taken off the 83 in between the track centres, 161 px, and agrees with the 16.56 in track at 32.5 px; the rear is drawn wider than it is tall, 167.5 px between the track centres, as the M4A1's own sheet's rear is. The rack is 2.8 to 2.9 m across in the two end views and 2.56 m in the plan, which draws it no wider than the hull, and the end views were taken. Both end views draw the rack and the bin 1.3 to 1.5 units lower than the side view does, while the hull and the turret agree in all three; the side view's heights were taken. The plan draws the bottom bank's muzzles 20 px ahead of the top bank's, where the side view has them level; the side view was taken.
